bill.title: Prohibits agreements intended to conceal certain information concerning development of data centers under MLUL.

action.description: Reported out of Senate Committee, 2nd Reading

posted_text:
🏢 NJ S4304 — NJ Wants to Stop Secret Data Center Deals

New Jersey is stepping in to make sure data center developers can't hide their plans. This bill says it’s against public policy for applicants – and anyone working for them – to use non-disclosure agreements with local governments or property sellers when building a ‘data center’ (defined as a facility storing and processing digital data). Developers must also confirm they haven’t used such agreements. ...
